$comment: omai (github.com/njtwomey/omai) packages installed as tarballs. scripts/fetch-omai.mjs puts each into vendor/omai/<name>.tgz (git-ignored), downloading it from the release over HTTPS (gh as the fallback), checks sha256 and refuses on mismatch; package.json depends on those files. One release per version, tag v<version>, all packages attached. To move to a release: `npm run omai:lock -- v<version> && npm run omai:fetch && npm install` (omai:lock rewrites this file from the release's asset digests).
